phase: Cass pilot generated; Blender surface cleanup and visual comparison in progress
prerequisite: Finish all concept entries, present consolidated gallery, inspect references; then begin Blender work.
reference_preparation: Separate front, profile and back into individual reference images in Blender. Never submit a full sheet containing three figures as one subject. Preserve source originals. Review every crop for complete hands, head and feet.
generation_policy: Persist unique task IDs and exact source hashes in a separate redesign output folder. Poll existing task; do not resubmit for observation timeouts. Review one coherent candidate in Blender before applying a paid batch to the remaining cast.
blender_requirements: Preserve face/body/clothing identity across living, undead, dialogue and FMV versions.
Inspect head, hands, fingers, limb lengths, garment topology and material seams.
Author facial controls for mouth, blinking and expressions; avoid a rigid talking portrait.
Rig shared animation conventions while retaining different body builds and clothing silhouettes.
Correct gun and melee grips using both hands and contact poses; no arbitrary appended arm.
Use separate undead materials and authored poses; prohibit cigarettes for undead and demons.
Keep interactive collision bodies and gameplay input independent from visual reference art.
validation: Actual Godot gameplay camera, all directions and full clips; run at 16:9 and 3840x2160, inspect hands, weapon contacts, movement foot sliding, seated poses, silhouettes, frame timing and performance. Concept image or task success is not runtime approval.
pilot_findings: One static mesh, no armature. Base color and normal maps4096x4096, packed material map2048x2048. Red jacket/face/body recognizable, but hair and collar artifacts need cleanup; not runtime approved.
